newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares rebound, but trading dull.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares rebound, but trading dull.

text.p: Shanghai B shares rebounded on Friday following losses in the past few days, but trading was dull with investors largely on the sidelines, brokers said.
The index ended up 0.131 points or 0.27 percent to 48.521 points on volume of 5.6 million shares worth $2.1 million. Of 41 B shares, 33 traded with 14 up, seven flat and 12 down.
Brokers said it was reasonable to see a rebound after several days' losses, but market sentiment was still bearish.
"Trading was focused more on falling stocks and volume on those rising was thin, which indicates the market is still bearish," a broker said.
"Drastic rises or falls will be impossible in the short term with the market finding a balance around 48 points," a second broker said.
Shanghai Narcisscus Electric Appliance was the star on a technical rebound, rising $0.006 or 4.76 percent to 0.132 on volume of 108,000 shares.
Heilongjiang Electric Power traded the most on profit-taking, falling $0.002 or 0.500 percent to $0.394 on volume of 691,400 shares.

Shanghai A shares closed sharply down on profit-taking following big gains in the past few days with investors becoming cautious due to high share prices, brokers said. The index has repeatedly hit two-year highs in the past week.

The A index slipped 13.377 points or 1.34 percent to 988.350 points on volume of 936.3 million shares worth 7.5 billion yuan. The SSE 30 blue-chip index fell 27.009 points or 1.05 percent to 2555.713 points.
Cai Hong Display Devices was the biggest loser on institutional selling, falling 0.96 yuan or 9.33 percent to 9.32 yuan on volume of 22.7 million shares.
